name: Chad

flag.description: Three vertical stripes of blue (hoist), yellow and red.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky, hope and water, yellow the sun and desert, and red progress, unity and sacrifice.

hook: Chad and Romania are near-twins in blue-yellow-red: Chad's blue is a slightly deeper indigo, and Andorra and Moldova add a coat of arms.
trivia: Chad's flag is almost identical to Romania's; the only difference is a slightly darker shade of blue.
Lake Chad has shrunk by around 90% since the 1960s.
